svg.title: Linux per-job run time: Git-native options and warm Git-snapshot
svg.desc: One production build on hosted-large agents with mirrors off. Every bar measures per-job run time (Ran in) from the Steps view, excluding queue wait and including plugin setup, checkout, hooks and the command. Full clone with agent defaults: 247 seconds. Blobless clone with eight checkout workers: 254 seconds. Treeless clone with eight checkout workers: 210 seconds. Shallow clone, depth one, with eight checkout workers: 205 seconds. Git-snapshot with eight checkout workers: 15 seconds, the slower of two warm snapshot and patch hits (15 and 13 seconds). No group spans are used. Native variants have one sample each; the two snapshot jobs are from the same build, not independent builds. Snapshot seeding is not shown. Shallow loses history; treeless makes path history slow. Bars share a linear scale starting at zero, two pixels per second. Source: supplied production Steps-view screenshot; build number not visible.
svg.text: Per-job run time (“Ran in”); excludes queue wait
Warm snapshot + patch hit; snapshot seed cost not shown.
One build; native n=1; snapshot jobs 15s and 13s. Linear from zero.
